waypoints.name: SR-20 Hairpin / Pond Pullout (east of Washington Pass)
waypoints.directions: From Washington Pass on SR 20, drive about 1.2 miles east and downhill to the hairpin turn. Park at the small dirt pullout beside a roadside pond on the south side of the highway. The highway over the pass closes in winter.

waypoints.name: Lexington Tower notch
waypoints.directions: Take the climbers' path from just west of the east-side guardrail, steeply through forest onto a scree and boulder slope below the east face, 30 to 45 minutes. Gain the treed ledge at the base by a roped 5.8 pitch or a flanking gully, climb the ten-pitch East Face (5.9+), and finish with the exposed catwalk traverse to the notch below the true summit.
